content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Line Items ## slug: line-items ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End A {{variable.Object_LineItem}} record stores price and quantity information for items related to an {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. You can create a one-off {{variable.Object_LineItem}} or create one that references {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s or [{{variable.Product_Salesforce}} {{variable.Object_SFProduct}}s](https://docs.blackthorn.io/v1/docs/stripe-billing-products){target=`_blank`} and {{variable.Object_PriceBook}}s. {{variable.Object_LineItem}} records can also be created automatically as part of the Event checkout process. :::(Info) (Will you be using standard Salesforce objects?) We suggest using the {{variable.Field_LineItem_Product}} and {{variable.Field_LineItem_PriceBook}} fields if you are going to create Invoices from standard Salesforce objects like Opportunities or Orders as those records already relate to Products. ::: ## Important Fields & Calculations ### Fields If any of the following fields are not on the {{variable.Object_LineItem}} page layout, please add them manually. | Field Label | API Name | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | Unit Price | bt_stripe__Unit_Price__c | The price for each unit of the {{variable.Object_LineItem}} | | Quantity | bt_stripe__Quantity__c | The quantity selected for a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} | | Tax Rate | bt_stripe__Tax_Rate__c | The tax rate for this {{variable.Object_LineItem}}. Set by the associated {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}}. Automatically set to 0 if the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxExempt}} is set to “True” (checked). | | Discount Code | bt_stripe__Code__c | The lookup for the associated discount {{variable.Object_Code}} record | | Is Not Discountable | bt_stripe__IsNotDiscountable__c | Check this field to prevent discounts from being applied to the {{variable.Object_LineItem}}. | | Discount | bt_stripe__Discount_Amount__c | The discount amount for this {{variable.Object_LineItem}} | ### Calculations #### Code Discount Amount {{variable.Field_LineItem_CodeDiscountAmt}} (bt_stripe__Code_Discount_Amount__c): The calculated {{variable.Field_LineItem_Discount}} (bt_stripe__Discount_Amount__c) related to the discount {{variable.Object_Code}} applied. #### Gross {{variable.Field_LineItem_Gross}} (bt_stripe__Net_Amount__c) = {{variable.Field_LineItem_UnitPrice}} * {{variable.Field_LineItem_Quantity}} #### Net {{variable.Field_LineItem_Net}} (bt_stripe__Subtotal_Amount__c) = {{variable.Field_LineItem_Gross}} (bt_stripe__Net_Amount__c) - {{variable.Field_LineItem_Discount}} (bt_stripe__Discount_Amount__c) #### Tax {{variable.Field_LineItem_Tax}} (bt_stripe__Tax_Amount__c) = {{variable.Field_LineItem_Net}} (bt_stripe__Subtotal_Amount__c) * {{variable.Field_LineItem_TaxRate}} (bt_stripe__Tax_Rate__c) #### Total {{variable.Field_LineItem_Total}} (bt_stripe__Total_Amount__c) = {{variable.Field_LineItem_Net}} (bt_stripe__Subtotal_Amount__c) + {{variable.Field_LineItem_Tax}} (bt_stripe__Tax_Amount__c) ## Add Line Items to your Order or Invoice 1. Navigate to your {{variable.Object_SFOrder}} or {{variable.Object_Invoice}} record. 2. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}, . 3. Set the values for the following fields. - {{variable.Field_LineItem_LineItemName}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_ServiceStartDat}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_ServiceEndDate}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_Invoice}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_Product}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_PriceBook}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_UnitPrice}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_Quantity}} - If the left blank, the default value is "1." - {{variable.Field_LineItem_CodeDiscountAmt}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_Event}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_EventItem}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_Description}} (Limit of 60 characters.) - {{variable.Field_LineItem_TaxRate}} - {{variable.Field_LineItem_DiscountCode}} 3. {{variable.Field_LineItem_AddDiscouAmount}} and {{variable.Field_LineItem_AddDiscPercenta}} * You can define these fields manually, or they will automatically be defined when setting a {{variable.Field_LineItem_DiscountCode}}. For example, * if you define a {{variable.Field_LineItem_DiscountCode}} that provides $10.00 off, the {{variable.Field_LineItem_AddDiscouAmount}} field will show $10.00. * if a {{variable.Field_LineItem_DiscountCode}} is not defined, you can manually enter a one-off discount in either field. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. Repeat the above process for all {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s. ![H_01_06_add line items](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_06_add%20line%20items.png){height="" width=""} *Now that you have added all {{variable.Object_LineItem}} to your {{variable.Object_SFOrder}} or {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, click [here](/v1/docs/documentlink-overview) to learn how {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}} works so that you can send this {{variable.Object_Invoice}} to your customer.* ## Use Salesforce Products and Price Books Setting the {{variable.Field_LineItem_SFProduct}} and {{variable.Field_LineItem_PriceBook}} fields on a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} automatically copies the values on those records to the {{variable.Object_LineItem}} fields when the record is saved. The {{variable.Field_LineItem_SFProduct}} and {{variable.Field_LineItem_PriceBook}} are optional. If a {{variable.Field_LineItem_SFProduct}} is set on the {{variable.Object_LineItem}} but not a {{variable.Field_LineItem_PriceBook}}, the logic will set the Standard Pricebook in the {{variable.Field_LineItem_PriceBook}} field. When a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} record is saved: - Values are pulled from the related {{variable.Object_SFProduct}} and set on {{variable.Field_LineItem_LineItemName}}, {{variable.Field_LineItem_Code}} and {{variable.Field_LineItem_Description}} fields if the corresponding Line Item field is blank. - Values are pulled from the {{variable.Object_PricebookEntry}} (based on the related {{variable.Object_PriceBook}} and {{variable.Object_SFProduct}}) and set on {{variable.Field_LineItem_ListUnitPrice}} and {{variable.Field_LineItem_UnitPrice}} fields if the Line Item field is blank. Once the fields are set, none of the {{variable.Object_LineItem}} fields listed in the section above will be updated by the related Product or Pricebook. This allows you to easily create {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s from objects that use {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} {{variable.Object_SFProduct}} and {{variable.Object_PriceBook}} while also providing the flexibility to set {{variable.Object_LineItem}} fields manually or from some other custom process. **Initial Setup**: If the {{variable.Field_LineItem_SFProduct}}, {{variable.Field_LineItem_PriceBook}}, and {{variable.Field_LineItem_ListUnitPrice}} fields are not on your {{variable.Object_LineItem}} page layout, please add them. *Lightning -> Navigate to setup > search for "Object Manager" > type in and select "Line Items" > edit the Page Layout and add the three fields.* *Classic -> Navigate to setup > search for "Objects" > type in and select "Line Items" > edit the Page Layout and add the three fields.* ![H_01_06_using salesforce products](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_06_using%20salesforce%20products.png){height="" width=""}
